name: leuk.dat
title: Leukemia Data
details:
Description: The following features are present:
`wbc`: white blood cell count;
`ag`: presence or absence of a certain
morphological characteristic in the white cells; and
`y`: binary response
variable, equals `1` if the patient survives more than 52 weeks, `0` otherwise.

Format: Numeric, 33 rows and 3 columns.
